decides_at_time: position_points_round (control, pass, sweep — each 1.0 per landing)
throw_points_round (1.0 per throw that reaches the minimum band)
mechanism.level_points: Sum of per-round raw points across all scorecards; the side with more total points wins. No tiebreak beyond initiative_side (karate senshu, not enabled for judo). A level bout with equal summed points has no winner — winner_side stays empty and method is DECISION.
mechanism.judo_board: JudoBoard.gd exists as a standalone RefCounted with full IJF SOR logic (waza-ari, yuko, shido, hansoku-make, golden score, decide-at-time). FightSimulation.gd never references or imports it — the board is unused by the simulation pipeline.

options.rule: Decision counts only real judo scores: throw_points (waza-ari) and osaekomi scores. Positions and submission attempts weighted 0 in the decision tally. A level bout at time is a draw (no golden score, no shido).

Option a plus golden score: when real judo scores are level at time, the contest enters golden score (JudoBoard.decide). First score in golden score — yuko, waza-ari or ippon — wins. Shido still absent.

Option b plus shido for passivity: repeated matte (unproductive ground) awards a shido to the less active fighter. Third shido is hansoku-make (opponent wins). Uses JudoBoard.apply for shido tracking and JudoBoard.decide for time expiry.
